_note: Physical mailboxes on the website (Peter, Nov 15 2026). Owners edit prices, box number ranges and the address here. Terms are 6 months or a year. reminder_days: how many days before the paid-through date a renewal reminder goes out (60 = the last two months, 30 = the last month, 7 = the last week, Peter Nov 17 2026); one more goes out the day after it lapses. They go out by text and email every morning on the live site (src/worker.ts), or when staff press Send due reminders.
_hold_note: After a box ends (it expired, or staff closed it), keep the holder's mail for hold_months, then return it to sender. Ended boxes stay on the staff Expired list for keep_months; search finds them after that too (Peter, Nov 16 2026).
